budget_audit: Original archived PPO plans specify 26+26+25 iterations = 19712 interactions; full-weight GRPO specifies 38x512=19456; residual GRPO specifies 37x512=18944. Preserve these original recipes, not the incorrect informal assertion that all budgets are identical. Record exact manifest-based interaction accounting in reporting.

topup.criterion: Any LF/PCL development mean loss in inclusive [4,6] pp, computed unrounded against same-runtime frozen nominal baseline
topup.trigger_uses: development outcomes only; never test outcomes
topup.old_candidate_runs: fixed original groups, no new topup of old candidates

matched_stop: Only add 3e-4, n=3 each LF/PCL; no 1e-4 or other rate based on results.
selection: Require development nominal loss <=5 pp in BOTH LF/PCL; maximize mean LF/PCL fault success, ties smaller worst loss then smaller rate.
collision_control: Fault and nominal for new models plus same-setting frozen controls; both collisions and ground are changed; validate initial-state comparability.
original_analysis: Keep original Table II configurations, all eight conditions and original nine Holm tests unchanged. Expanded-grid analysis covers LF/PCL only.
statistics: Independent training runs; descriptive mean/SD and Welch-Satterthwaite contrasts; no additions to original nine-test family.
